notes.title: Year 1 Update! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

I can't quite believe I'm writing this, but Disobedient Sheep has been out for a year today! 🎉🎉🎉 

It's crazy to think that the small, sheep-herding videogame that I started programming in my bedroom, is now a small sheep-herding game that I finished programming in my spare bedroom. 

Seriously though, thanks to everyone for playing. it's been a crazy year, and I'm so happy to have been able to bring a bit of silly joy to people, every nice comment and review makes the hours of work a bit more worthwhile. 

Anyway! I'm in danger of getting too sentimental.  To mark the occasion, we're releasing an update to add Steam achievements, and the game will be 35% off for the next five days. I hope you enjoy it! Happy Hunting.



And for a bit of a throwback... Here's two screenshots from some of the earliest-ever builds. The ifrst is from - literally - the first day of coding. The second was a couple of months later, with our first 3D prototype.

notes.title: Remote Play Together Support
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We hope you've been enjoying Disobedient Sheep so far. 

In our first major update, v1.4.1, we've added the much-requested option to [b]disable controller sharing 🎉🎉 🎉 [/b] This is off by default, but can be toggled in the [i]Accessibility[/i] options of the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34563244/2cb98260bfd4bf394f78828197e320d034fa01e3.jpg[/img]


The biggest result of this is that Steam Remote Play together is now much easier to use. We've had a bit of a go so far, and are super pleased with the performance! Please try it out, and let us know how it works for you.

SicklyDove games🐑

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Sorry that we've been so quiet recently - we've been super hard at work finishing off Disobedient Sheep, and have some good news and bad news.


So, bad news first. Sorry to say that we're going to have to delay the release until Q1 next year. I hope to be able  to share some more information about why soon, but you can hopefully expect Disobedient Sheep to be available on a few more platforms from day one.

Now for the good news! The game is finished, and we're now just working on very minor bugfixes and art improvements. If for any reason things don't work out with our new platforms, there's nothing stopping us from releasing on Steam tomorrow!

Thanks for sticking with us. Here's the first screenshot of our new Sheep-Football mode - be sure to check out the store page for a new gameplay video!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34563244/c96f5a497c844c865ba8899f09fc21cb57620dca.png[/img]


-- Laurie

notes.title: Back to work
notes.content:
What a month! It's our first weekend back from exhibiting at [url=https://www.egx.net/rezzed/2019/show-floor]EGX Rezzed[/url] and [url=https://insomniagamingfestival.com/indie/]Insomnia64[/url], which were absolutely mental! I've been talking so much that my jaw might fall off, but people are loving the game and I can't wait to get it into your hands. 

Some good news from Rezzed: we've been featured in Get Indie Gaming's 
 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArcB0vy83jY&t=2s]top 10 new games of Rezzed[/url], which is awesome! Please watch the video, see how well we did, and check out the other great games. Also don't miss [url=https://geekybrummie.com/blog/the-geeky-brummie-podcast-issue-159/]The Geeky Brummie podcast[/url], who interviewed us at i64 - they're a great group of people.

Finally, I'm very excited to introduce our next playable character - Ben the Border Collie! Ben has the responsibility of looking after all the sheep in our main menu, and you can see him here, along with a sneaky preview of our new work-in-progress player-select screen!

Stay tuned for some more interviews from Rezzed and Insomnia, and a very special announcement coming soon...

notes.title: Play Disobedient Sheep in April!
notes.content:
Hi friends! 

We're hard at work polishing Disobedient Sheep ready for launch later this year, and hope you're all as excited to get your paws on it as we are.

If you're based in the UK and can't wait until then, we're excited to announce that you'll be able to play the game - and chat with the devs - next month!  Come down to [url=https://www.egx.net/rezzed/2019/show-floor]EGX Rezzed[/url] in London, or [url=https://www.egx.net/rezzed/2019/show-floor]Insomnia 64[/url] in Birmingham and find us with the Tentacle Collective, then keep up with us on the day by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/DisobSheepGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/Disobedient-Sheep-423367328410166]Facebook[/url]

Can't wait to see you! 🐑🐑🐑💣
